onboarding.label: Onboarding
onboarding.nav.label: Onboarding navigation
onboarding.welcome.title: Record something great
onboarding.welcome.tagline: Reelform turns a plain screen recording into a designed demo — zooms, cursor, frame and captions, all on your machine.
onboarding.permissions.title: Reelform needs a few permissions
onboarding.permissions.subtitle: Granted once. Nothing is captured until you press record.
onboarding.permissions.windowsNote: Screen capture needs no permission on Windows. Microphone and camera access are controlled in Settings › Privacy.
onboarding.permissions.unavailable: Permissions are managed by the desktop app.
onboarding.permissions.noneNeeded: No permissions are needed on this system.
onboarding.permissions.restricted: {permission} is restricted by a device policy.
onboarding.permissions.denied.darwin: Access was denied. Turn on Reelform under {settings} › Privacy & Security › {permission}.
onboarding.permissions.denied.other: Access was denied. Turn on Reelform under {settings} › Privacy › {permission}.
onboarding.permissions.restartNote: macOS will ask you to restart Reelform after granting.
onboarding.permission.microphone.descrip: Record your voice alongside the screen.
onboarding.permission.accessibility.desc: Track the cursor and detect clicks for auto-zoom.
onboarding.permission.notifications.desc: Tells you when an export finishes.
onboarding.defaults.title: Where should recordings go?
onboarding.defaults.subtitle: You can change any of this later in Settings.
onboarding.defaults.autoDeleteRaw.descri: The project keeps its edit, the source file is removed.
onboarding.defaults.saveFailed: Couldn't save your settings. Try again.
onboarding.done.title: You're all set
onboarding.done.body: Reelform is ready. You can change these any time in Settings.
